## Upgrade notes

If you installed the plugin with `git clone` inside the plugins folder and committed with v0.1.0, your backup may hold `plugins/learnharness-git/` as an embedded repository. Remove it once with `git rm --cached plugins/learnharness-git` in the learning data folder, then commit.

## Fixes

- **Plugins installed with `git clone`:** a plugin folder with its own `.git` is kept out of the backup instead of being committed as an embedded repository. Its `data/` is not backed up.
- **Install instructions:** the prebuilt zip is now the recommended install. It already contains the `learnharness-git/` folder, and Settings no longer needs reopening after **Refresh plugins**.

**Full changelog:** [v0.1.0...v0.1.1](https://github.com/heohlee/learnharness-git/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1)

[Documentation](https://github.com/heohlee/learnharness-git#readme)
